tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Firms in the U.S. FDA's food records whose name matches, best first, each with its country, city, FDA establishment number (FEI), counts of FDA actions and its Supplier Brief page. Also finds a firm by its FEI number.

tools.name: get_supplier_record
tools.description: Everything FDA's public records show about one firm, dated: the FSVP compliance facts (import alert listings, refusals with FDA's charges, inspection classifications including OAI, compliance actions, warning letters, recalls), the latest records of each kind with FDA's reference, similar records co

tools.name: get_import_alert
tools.description: One FDA import alert by its number (such as 99-19 or 16-81): its subject, how many firms are on its Red List and Green List, the firms listed (optionally only one country's), and FDA's page.

tools.name: get_food_import_changes
tools.description: Food import news from FDA's records over the last 7 days: firms added to or taken off import alert Red Lists, food warning letters FDA posted, foreign food plants FDA classified Official Action Indicated, and how many food shipments FDA reported refusing, with the commonest charges.

tools.name: check_supplier_list
tools.description: Up to 20 suppliers checked at once against FDA's records: for each, the firm matched (or several to choose from by address, or none found under that name), what FDA has on record and its page.
